_comment_top: Robomuffin Image Factory — Batch Render sample. Top-level options apply to every row. References can be either absolute paths or bare filenames resolved against reference_base_dir. The three OPTIONAL scale-hint fields (size, dimensions, relative_size) help the model render the subject at the correct real-world scale instead of filling the frame.

rows._comment: Scale hints anchor the model to a real-world size. Without them, a 3-inch water spout would render filling the frame.

rows.prompt: Mounted to the side of a marble countertop, kitchen scene.
